name: dalel
description: Review a requirements document before any code is written: contradictions, gaps, untestable wording and API-spec errors, every finding backed by a verbatim quote.

interface.longDescription: Runs the Dalel command-line agent on a requirements document and reports a verdict, findings with verbatim quotes, blocking questions for the author and draft test cases. Criteria: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 and IEEE 830.
defaultPrompt: Check the requirements document before we implement it.
Is this spec ready for development?
Review docs/requirements.md and ask me the blocking questions.
